payload.core_mechanism_summary: Digit DP counts numbers ≤ X with digit sum 10, using a 2D state (index, sum) and a tight flag. Wrapper binary search locates the k-th perfect number.
payload.rationale: The solution defines a DP table with dimensions for index and sum, plus a tight flag typical of digit DP. This aligns with dp_2d_state. Binary search is secondary.
